findings.failure_path: A deleted owner and its claimed successor can already share a non-empty boilerplate file. Their blob intersection then passes even when no architecture rules move. An otherwise valid successor row with retires: consequently excuses deletion of the entire owner; the nothing-carried fixture misses this case because it assumes no shared blobs.
findings.smallest_fix: Bind retirement verification to migrated rule-bearing content, excluding pre-existing incidental overlap. Add a negative fixture where both packages already share boilerplate and all retired rules are deleted.

findings.failure_path: Collapsing both rewritten BASE and HEAD hides added content. For example, a third owner's regular JSON reference file can change a value from go-microservice-architecture to software-architecture/software-architecture. The slash-separated repetition collapses to software-architecture, so the malformed value receives the identifier-rename exemption without ordinary behavioral evidence. The existing smuggling fixture only appends unrelated text.
findings.smallest_fix: Compare HEAD without normalization. Limit any BASE deduplication to explicitly recognized prose lists, excluding paths and structured values, and add the duplicated-path negative fixture.

findings.failure_path: The Markdown reference exemptions key only on ledger path and cited reference. Any newly appended row can therefore reuse one of these deleted reference paths and bypass validation, although the rationale authorizes only historical rows. Route-token digests do not bind this separate exemption to those rows.
findings.smallest_fix: Bind each exemption to the exact historical row digest and expected use count. Add a fixture appending a new row with the same stale reference and require failure.

findings.failure_path: grep scans the entire SKILL.md rather than its frontmatter. findings.smallest_fix: Parse the actual frontmatter name and use a shipped-content fingerprint for retirement recognition. Test a valid personal skill with a misleading body example and the same marker filename.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the supplied packet was inspected, but it omits the migration scripts and source/destination corpus needed to verify zero loss, per-case sonnet results needed to establish non-regression, required full-lane validation evidence, and selected skill bodies other than software-architecture. The profile's assertions cannot independently establish those checks or completion of every requested skill lens.
